verdict.rationale: cfo.ai claims it drafts a board/investor deck from last night's numbers on the live model, can share a read-only report link with the board, and forecasts revenue, costs and cash. However, the board deck is described only in a single marketing line, with no documentation of what the pack contains or how it is generated. Missing for 10: documented board-pack contents (metrics, variance commentary, forecast sections), a how-to or docs page for generating the deck, an export format for slides, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate a board pack (metrics, variance commentary, forecast) from the live model instead of assembling slides by hand

citations.quote: Board and investor work that starts before you do: a deck drafted off last night's numbers, on the model rather than in a thread.
Send investors or your board a read-only link to a report.
Forecast revenue, costs, and cash from what drives your business.
